instruction.text: Put car objects into the left basket, watch objects into the middle basket, and wooden_toy objects into the right basket, then reset the robot arm.

semantic_contract: Put every object of each named category into the basket the instruction assigns to that category. The left basket is the one toward world -X, on the side of the table where the left arm is mounted; the right basket is the one toward world +X, on the right-arm side; the middle basket is between them.
Lower the objects into the baskets rather than leaving them above the openings.
Both arms must be back at the poses they held when the episode reset, at the same instant that everything else in this contract is true.
